primaryMetric: Native click to expected latest v1 artifact and enabled review controls across a painted frame, milliseconds.
verdict: Faster in constrained lab conditions; default local results inconclusive.

environment.fixture: Same isolated local Supabase database with latest migrations and 160 additional benchmark sessions
limitations: Browser CPU/network throttling on desktop, not a physical phone or field measurement.
Other desktop processes remained active; side/input/condition order interleaved.

baselineAndCandidate.requestTimingUnits: Per-request startMs is relative to harness wallStart, not native click; durations are rounded milliseconds. Use approvalTimings for RSC-aligned click-relative HTTP timing.

caveats: Profiled durations include probes and tracing overhead; excluded from numeric comparison.
Main-task intervals and sampled time kinds are approximate diagnostics, not an additive CPU budget.
First readiness excludes later SDK establishment and post-join catchup.
Request recording window ends250ms after observed readiness. Lower counts do not establish total background request reduction.
